0. 42903902 | 2 spans | Clinical improvement of necrobiosis lipoidica with topical ruxolitinib.

0. 42903902 | span 0 | Recent studies have identified upregulation of inflammatory cytokines, such as interferon gamma (IFN-γ), contributing to constitutive activation of the janus kinase-signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK-STAT) signaling pathway in granulomatous diseases.3,4 Targeting this pathway with JAK inhibition provides a promising therapeutic approach to NL, supported by clinical success in granulomatous diseases such as sarcoidosis.3

0. 42903902 | span 1 | The rapid and sustained clinical response observed with topical ruxolitinib suggests involvement of JAK-STAT signaling in the pathogenesis of NL, with constitutive pathway activation contributing to chronic granulomatous inflammation.4 This is supported by prior reports of clinical remission of NL with topical JAK-STAT inhibitor therapy.5,6 Our patient’s response is consistent with molecular network analyses identifying IFN-γ driven JAK-STAT activation as a driver of NL and JAK inhibition as a validated therapeutic intervention.7

1. 42756851 | 1 spans | Decreased expression of immune activator WARS1 and other pro-inflammatory mediators in type 1-like macrophages as an associated mode of action in response to fucoidan from marine brown algae.
